verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a Research Agent that takes a question at a selectable effort level (Fastest to Smartest), pulls from many source types, and produces iterable artifacts. It also offers automatic research reports from any research question, plus a Systematic Review workflow that chains search, screening, full-text screening, extraction and reporting, which the API can run end to end. Hands-on reports of inaccurate summaries and missed key papers concern output quality rather than whether the investigation is multi-step, so they lower confidence but do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how the agent autonomously plans and sequences investigation steps, and independent hands-on corroboration that the agent's multi-step research is reliable.
